en.help.mesh.copy_point_cloud: Copy the selected mesh into a separate point cloud that has its own visibility control in the Browser.
en.help.mesh.copy_facet_cloud: Draw a loop on the scan, add or subtract patches, then copy the selected vertices into a new point cloud.
en.help.pointcloud.copy_snippet: Choose a visible point cloud and draw one or more loops to copy those points into an independent cloud.
en.help.mesh.auto_sections: Create editable section sketches through the source mesh at evenly spaced or explicit station offsets. Hide the scan after applying to trace the profiles.
